sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: An evergreen tree endemic to the southern Western Ghats of India, occurring in wet evergreen and shola forests. It grows about 10–15 m tall.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The opposite, leathery leaves are about 5–11 × 1.3–2.5 cm. White or pale yellow flowers occur on separate plants. The subglobose to oblong berry is about 2–4 cm long and usually contains one seed.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use specific to this species was found; uses of other Garcinia species cannot be attributed to it by analogy.
